request: Preserve this template, choose readable views, reuse measured native dimensions or existing PMI, and use verified feature tables where useful. The delivered 2D drawing alone must uniquely define the entire nominal geometry, with complete independent dimension chains and no duplicate driving definitions. Record a source-bound geometric reconstruction/nonredundancy audit and fail if a necessary size, location, direction, depth or relationship remains unresolved. Tolerances and surface finish may be deferred. Deliver only DWG and PDF. Lay out measured fully dimensioned view blocks with 3 mm padding and 12 mm clearances. Place tables at upper right. Use progressively smaller common scales with fixed text and arrow sizes, target 55% occupied envelope area (prefer 45%-65%), and distinguish heavy model edges from thin annotation lines. Use dynamic scale notes.
